Generalized tabulation checks

check_tabulation_domain.Rd

Runs generalized structural and temporal checks that map to a subset of the core observability rule catalog.

Usage

check_tabulation_domain(
  data,
  domain = NULL,
  key_vars,
  required_vars = character(),
  start_end_pairs = list(),
  non_negative_vars = character(),
  date_vars = character(),
  visit_order_var = NULL,
  subject_var = "USUBJID"
)

Arguments

data

A domain-level data.frame.

domain

Optional domain name used in issue messages.

key_vars

Character vector of key variables.

required_vars

Character vector of required variables.

start_end_pairs

Named list of start/end pairs, for example list(c("AESTDT", "AEENDT")).

non_negative_vars

Variables expected to be non-negative.

date_vars

Variables expected to contain full dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.

visit_order_var

Optional variable used for within-subject ordering.

subject_var

Subject identifier variable.

Value

A data.frame with columns check, severity, message, and n.

Examples

check_tabulation_domain(
  data = example_sdtm_lb(),
  domain = "LB",
  key_vars = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "LBSEQ"),
  required_vars = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "LBSEQ", "LBTESTCD")
)
#> [1] check    severity message  n       
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
